name: convex-expert
description: Use when writing or editing application code under convex/, including schemas, functions, indexes, HTTP actions, and config. Do not use for read-only audits, docs lookup, or deployment operations.

findings.excerpt: - SELF-VERIFY RULE — before declaring backend work done, verify it compiles and pushes: run `bunx tsc --noEmit` and push it to a deployment. Prefer the project'
- CLI: `bunx convex dev --once` pushes to dev. `bunx convex deploy` always targets prod (add `--yes` to skip the prompt). `bunx convex run --prod <fn>` runs on
